content: Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of imatinib by altering hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown, so close monitoring is recommended. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of imipramine through its impact on CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Nelfinavir increases the levels of inhaled indacaterol due to modulation of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and CYP3A4 activities. No dose adjustment is required at the 75 mcg dose, but close monitoring is recommended. Indinavir increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein efflux transporter activity. Both drugs increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Alternative therapies should be considered. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of indinavir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration should be avoided, and alternative drugs are recommended. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of discontinued infigratinib (DSC) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use alternative drugs. Nelfinavir decreases the effects of insulin aspart due to insulin resistance associated with protease inhibitors. Hyperglycemia has been reported. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Nelfinavir decreases the effects of insulin degludec through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Protease inhibitors may cause new-onset diabetes mellitus (DM), exacerbate existing DM, and induce hyperglycemia due to insulin resistance. Nelfinavir decreases the effects of insulin detemir, insulin glargine, insulin glulisine, inhaled insulin, insulin lispro, insulin NPH, and regular human insulin due to insulin resistance associated with protease inhibitors. Hyperglycemia has been reported. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of irinotecan and irinotecan liposomal by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration should be avoided, and alternative drugs are recommended. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of isavuconazonium sulfate by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated. Isoniazid increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of isradipine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown, so close monitoring is recommended. Istradefylline increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein activity. Close monitoring is necessary. Do not exceed 20 mg/day of istradefylline when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Itraconazole increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein activity. Nelfinavir also increases the levels or effects of itraconazole. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown, so close monitoring is recommended. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of ivabradine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated. Ivacaftor increases the levels of nelfinavir by affecting P-glycoprotein activity. Nelfinavir also increases the levels or effects of ivacaftor by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Ivacaftor dosage should be reduced when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of ivosidenib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration should be avoided, and alternative therapies are recommended. If unavoidable, reduce the ivosidenib dose to 250 mg daily. If the strong CYP3A4 inhibitor is discontinued, increase the ivosidenib dose to the recommended 500 mg daily after at least five half-lives of the inhibitor. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of ixabepilone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Nelfinavir decreases the levels or effects of ketamine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Ketoconazole increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein activity. Nelfinavir also increases the levels or effects of ketoconazole. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown, so close monitoring is recommended. Nelfinavir and lacosamide both increase each other's levels by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Consider reducing the lacosamide dose when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Nelfinavir and lamivudine both increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Lansoprazole decreases the levels of nelfinavir through an unspecified mechanism. Co-administration is contraindicated. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of lapatinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Lapatinib also increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein activity. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of larotrectinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration should be avoided, and alternative drugs are recommended. If unavoidable, reduce the larotrectinib dose by 50%. Lasmiditan increases the levels of nelfinavir by affecting P-glycoprotein activity. Co-administration should be avoided, and alternative drugs are recommended. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of lefamulin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration should be avoided, and alternative drugs are recommended. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of lemborexant by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors should be avoided. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of leniolisib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration should be avoided, and alternative drugs are recommended. Nelfinavir increases the levels of letermovir by decreasing its metabolism. Letermovir also increases the levels of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of levamlodipine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Monitor for symptoms of hypotension and edema when co-administered with CYP3A4 inhibitors. Levo-ketoconazole increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein activity. Nelfinavir also increases the levels or effects of levo-ketoconazole. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown, so close monitoring is recommended. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of levomilnacipran by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Do not exceed 80 mg/day of levomilnacipran when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of levonorgestrel (intrauterine) by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration should be avoided, and alternative drugs are recommended. Nelfinavir decreases the effects of linagliptin and liraglutide due to insulin resistance associated with protease inhibitors. Hyperglycemia has been reported. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Nelfinavir increases the levels of lomitapide by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated. Lomitapide also increases the levels of nelfinavir by affecting P-glycoprotein activity. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of lonafarnib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of lopinavir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration should be avoided, and alternative drugs are recommended. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of loratadine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Loratadine also increases the levels of nelfinavir by affecting P-glycoprotein activity. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Lorlatinib decreases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of lorlatinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration should be avoided, and alternative drugs are recommended. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of lovastatin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated.
